description: Poland BDO Waste Registry Scraper. Rejestr BDO - baza danych o odpadach. Search 674,000+ waste management entities by name or NIP. Returns BDO registry number, company name, NIP, and address (province, district, commune, city, street, postcode). Answers "is this company in the BDO register, and what is its BDO number?" - registration status, waste codes and permits are behind a BDO login and are not part of the public register. No API exists. ESG compliance, environmental due diligence. Gospodarka odpadami. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum entities to return. The registry serves 50 per page and the actor pages through until it reaches this limit or runs out of matches. Default: 100. Set to 0 to return every match.
maxResults.title: Max Results

query.description: Search by company name, NIP, NIP EU, or BDO registry number.
query.title: Search Query

name: regdata_bdo_waste_registry
